title: Design System: Kai Tak Departure Board

display.purpose: Board title, printed black on the marigold frame.

drum.purpose: Every flap character; monospace is structural to grid alignment.

status.purpose: Small backlit bilingual status label; plain text, not flaps.

shadows.name: frame-drop
shadows.purpose: The marigold frame casting onto the wall — the only cast shadow in the system.

shadows.name: lamp-glow
shadows.purpose: Emitted halo of a lit boarding lamp.

motion.name: flap-flip
motion.purpose: The folding-leaf flip of a drum cell, stepping char by char.

motion.name: hud-transition
motion.value: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: cells snap and the board falls silent.

breakpoints.name: fluid
breakpoints.value: none — the board is composed at native size and transform:scale-d whole to fit the viewport

components.name: Flap Cell
components.description: The atom of the board — a fixed-size mechanical drum character at rest.
components.css: .ds-flap { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:20px; height:28px; background:#1A1A1A; color:#F5F3EC; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-weight:700; font-size:18px; border-radius:3px; }

components.name: Flap Cell (revised time)
components.description: Drum cell for the revised/actual time column — glyph in revised red.
components.css: .ds-flap-time { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:20px; height:28px; background:#1A1A1A; color:#FF5040; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-weight:700; font-size:18px; border-radius:3px; }

components.name: Airline Card
components.description: Light sticker carrying the carrier logo; brand-colored code chip is the fallback.
components.css: .ds-airline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:50px; height:26px; background:#F5F3EC; color:#00594C; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-weight:700; font-size:16px; border-radius:3px; }

components.name: Boarding Lamp
components.description: Row-end status dot; lit red with a glow means act now, else a dim ember.
components.css: .ds-lamp { display:inline-block; width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; background:#4A1210; } .ds-lamp-lit { background:#E8261C; box-shadow:0 0 8px 2px rgba(232,38,28,0.8); }

components.name: Status Label
components.description: Two-line backlit bilingual status; plain text, does not flip.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; line-height:1.15; } .ds-status-en { font-family:Oswald,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:0.06em; color:#E9E4D4; } .ds-status-zh { font-family:'TW-Kai','Kaiti TC','STKaiti',serif; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; color:#E9E4D4; }

components.name: HUD Pill
components.description: Corner navigation / sound control; the only chrome outside the board.
components.css: .ds-hud { display:inline-block; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-weight:600; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:0.08em; color:#F3E4BE; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid rgba(217,166,43,0.6); border-radius:999px; background:rgba(217,166,43,0.12); cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms ease,color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-hud:hover, .ds-hud:focus-visible { color:#0D0D0D; background:#E8B534; border-color:#E8B534; outline:none; }

narrative.overview: This is not a UI that references a split-flap board; it is one, rebuilt in the browser and wired to live Hong Kong International Airport data. A matte black board sits inside a scuffed marigold frame under hall lighting; mechanical drum characters clatter over from blank as today's real flights, gates, and codeshares roll up the schedule. Bilingual by construction: English condensed grotesque and Traditional-Chinese kaiti carry equal weight. Color is almost entirely structural, and red is reserved for things happening now. The delight is not decoration; it is the mechanism.
keyCharacteristics: Physical artifact, not app skin — matte board in a marigold frame.
Structural color: near-monochrome surface, red spent only on live events.
Motion is the product: flip, cascade, rotate, clack.
Bilingual parity — condensed grotesque + brush kaiti, equal weight.
Fixed-canvas: the board is composed once and scaled whole to the viewport.

rules.name: The Red-Means-Now Rule
rules.body: Red is forbidden as decoration. It appears in exactly two places: a lit boarding lamp (#E8261C) and a revised time (#FF5040). If red is on the board, something is happening to that flight right now.

rules.name: The One-Frame Rule
rules.body: Marigold (#E8B534) is the frame and the HUD accent — nothing else. Never a fill behind data, never a text color on the board field.

rules.name: The Monospace-Is-Structural Rule
rules.body: The drum column type must stay monospace; the alignment of the board depends on every glyph having the same advance.

rules.name: The Bilingual-Parity Rule
rules.body: English and Traditional Chinese share the row and the visual weight. Chinese is always kaiti (TW-Kai), never a Noto/Hei sans.

rules.name: The One-Shadow Rule
rules.body: The frame is the only element that casts. No flap, card, button, or label gets a drop shadow; depth on the board is the flap fold or an emitted glow.

dos: Do keep the drum column in IBM Plex Mono — grid alignment depends on a fixed advance width.
Do set all Chinese in TW-Kai kaiti; re-run scripts/subset-kai-font.sh after adding new glyphs.
Do spend red only on live events — a lit lamp (#E8261C) or a revised time (#FF5040).
Do give English and Traditional Chinese equal weight on every row and label.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion — snap cells to value and silence the clack.
Do scale the whole board to fit; compose at native size, never reflow the grid.
donts: Don't turn this into a flat Material dashboard or app skin — it is a physical artifact.
Don't use glassmorphism, neon gradients, or the 'departure board reimagined' idiom.
Don't ship SaaS clichés: card grids, tracked eyebrow kickers, hero-metric tiles, 01/02/03 numbers.
Don't add skeuomorphic overkill — no fake screws, heavy bevels, or drop-shadow soup.
Don't give any flap, card, button, or label a drop shadow — the frame is the only element that casts.
Don't set Chinese in Noto / a Hei sans — it must be kaiti.
Don't use marigold as a fill behind data or a text color on the board field.
